about_the_game:
Remi is a single-dev passion project that is inspired by a mixture of action RPGs and Souls-like games. Players can traverse the post apocalyptic world as Remi and eliminate enemies known as the Blighted using a range of combat abilities. Defeat all the enemies along your path and fulfill your final mission.

Remi is a work in progress and will receive updates over time.

STORY:

A devastating plague brought into the world by a powerful demon—The Overlord—has reduced civilization to ruin. The infection transforms ordinary people into Blighted: mindless, bloodthirsty husks with only one cure—death.

In humanity’s darkest hour, a band of champions rose to fight back. They were called the Vanguard—the most powerful heroes the world had ever known—united under one mission: ELIMINATE THE BLIGHTED.

After years of brutal war, the Vanguard succeeded in defeating the Overlord. But victory came at a terrible price. With his final breath, the demon unleashed one last curse, infecting the heroes themselves.

Now, only one remains.

Remi, once a celebrated warrior of the Vanguard, stands as the last uncorrupted survivor. For reasons unknown, she alone is immune to the plague. With her comrades lost to corruption, she must hunt them down one by one—each battle a clash against fallen legends twisted into monstrous forms.

The world teeters on the brink of complete collapse. Driven by duty, vengeance, and survival, Remi must see her mission through:
Destroy the Blighted. End the plague. Avenge the Vanguard.

A single-dev passion project.

name: Remi

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: ntel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti / RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: A plague unleashed by the Overlord turned humanity into the Blighted. The Vanguard fought to save the world—but fell to corruption. Now Remi, the last uninfected hero, must hunt her former allies and end the plague once and for all. An action RPG passion project made by a single dev.
